decision.rationale: The fresh exact-SHA replay is byte-identical for all three M381 outputs. An independent rebuild from all 40 frozen M248 packed traces and the q32 catalog reconstructs all 17,280 phases, exact used-center bitmaps/runs, PWP/fallback populations and every sweep point with zero mismatch. A concrete 32-byte-aligned direct-address layout exists, and a credit-aware L8/D8/II1 simulation has no post-start underflow for descriptor counts through the frozen maximum 2,400. No P0/P1 blocks bounded VCS, but one-cycle seal/run decoding, physical addresses, FIFO credit behavior and cycle recurrence remain RTL obligations.

blocking_thresholds.interpretation: The admitted robust cmd32/L8 result cannot tolerate a serialized replay penalty of 0.295592 cycle per active descriptor or more while retaining 1.05x. The M381 0.25 point passes and 0.345 point fails as expected.

findings.title: Direct-address PWP layout is constructible but not address-traced
findings.detail: A non-overlapping 64-KiB witness places pattern, two 6,144-byte weights and 32 direct 576-byte PWP slots per tile on 32-byte boundaries. M381 nevertheless emits aggregate command/run counts rather than every burst address and length. VCS must assert base+center_id*576, maximal-run coalescing, no remap, no unused-slot transfer and bank bounds.

findings.title: One-cycle count/bitmap seal and run decoding are pre-RTL assumptions
findings.detail: The independent recurrence charges exactly 17,280 seal cycles and one pattern command per phase, but there is no timing proof that active_count, the 32-bit bitmap and first run are atomically available for the following DMA sequencer. VCS must cover bitmap edge cases and DC must close this path or add honestly charged cycles.

findings.title: L8/D8/II1 is constructively feasible but not yet an implemented port protocol
findings.detail: A credit simulation that reserves FIFO space for every outstanding read reaches at most eight inflight responses, at most six queued responses and zero post-start underflows for 1, 8, 9, 89 and 2,400 descriptors at the four-cycle minimum service. The actual 1RW bank, response ordering, full credit, epoch changes and reset/stall behavior still require VCS assertions.

findings.title: The robust margin is highly sensitive to serialized descriptor blocking
findings.detail: At cmd32/L8 the exact 1.05x boundary is only 0.2955918 extra cycle per replayed active descriptor. M381's analytical 0.25 penalty remains 1.056935x at cmd8, while 0.345 falls to 1.048620x. Any shared-port or ready/valid design that serializes even a minority of descriptors must be measured as a separate point and may invalidate GO.

findings.title: The admitted result remains module- and cohort-scoped
findings.detail: 1.0763829x covers four PAFT S10 bottleneck Conv inputs under the frozen q32/O4 recurrence. It excludes controller/matcher/SRAM area and power, RTL cycle match, macro timing, other network operators, system Amdahl and cross-sequence generalization; it is not a paper headline or full-network speedup.

vcs_required_gates: Exact active descriptor payload and lowest-ID q32 tie behavior; use_pwp iff 1+distance<population; only original16==0 may be elided
Atomic active_count/used_center_bitmap seal and correct maximal consecutive run enumeration for empty, singleton, all-32 and fragmented bitmaps
Direct PWP address base+center_id*576, one weight plus PWP-run commands per tile, 32-byte alignment, no remap and no bank overflow
One 1RW request per cycle with fixed L<=8 response, D8 outstanding-response credit, in-order delivery and no per-descriptor blocking
Tile1 DMA overlap with exact exposed-cycle accounting, randomized ready/valid stalls, reset/epoch attacks and two-tile conservation
Cycle miter against frozen small traces at cmd32/L8 and a blocking negative control before any DC claim
